rfp_requirements.title: Submit Quotes through NJSTART eProcurement system
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must submit their Quotes in response to this Bid Solicitation through the State of New Jersey's eProcurement system, NJSTART.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain responsibility for information security
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must establish and maintain responsibility for information security within the organization.

rfp_requirements.title: No Arbitration
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must accept that the State will not agree to binding or non-binding arbitration, regardless of any contrary provision in the Proposal, SFA, or SOW.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not rely on expiring Contract data
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders should not rely upon or use data or information from the expiring T1628 Contract when preparing their response, as the current Bid Solicitation addresses the State's current requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose alignment with industry-standard security frameworks
rfp_requirements.description: Indicate whether the organization aligns its information security program with industry standard frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Top 20, or CoBIT, and list which framework(s) are employed.

rfp_requirements.title: Document Exception Management Policy processes
rfp_requirements.description: If an Exception Management Policy is employed, document the processes for submission, review, documentation, and application of exceptions to compliance with established information security policies and standards.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional information for Information Security Program Management control area
rfp_requirements.description: Optional – provide any additional information relative to the Information Security Program Management (PM) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional info on Access Management
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the Access Management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional info on Configuration Management
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide additional information relative to the Configuration Management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Properly configure and protect endpoint devices
rfp_requirements.description: The organization must ensure that endpoint devices are properly configured and measures are implemented to protect the organization's information and information systems from a loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional info on Endpoint Security
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide additional information relative to the Endpoint Security control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional info on ICS/SCADA/OT Security
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide additional information relative to the ICS/SCADA/OT Security control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional ICS/SCADA/OT Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe IoT Devices and Security
rfp_requirements.description: List and describe any IoT devices used across the organization and detail how those devices are secured physically, administratively, and technically, including network segmentation, access and authentication, and security updates.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional IoT Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional Mobile Device Security Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional Network Security Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional Cloud Security Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional Change Management Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit questions only via NJSTART Q&A Tab
rfp_requirements.description: All questions and inquiries must be submitted electronically via the Q&A Tab of the Bid Solicitation in NJSTART.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with all applicable laws
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must comply with all local, State, and Federal laws, rules, and regulations applicable to the contract and to the goods delivered and/or services performed.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Exceptions to State Standard Terms and Conditions (SSTC)
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must submit any exceptions to the State of NJ Standard Terms and Conditions per Section 2.2.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Detailed Description If Unable to Certify Iran Disclosure
rfp_requirements.description: If Contractor cannot certify to the Iran disclosure, it shall provide a detailed and precise description of such activities on the form.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Anti-Discrimination Laws
rfp_requirements.description: All parties agree not to discriminate in employment and to abide by all anti-discrimination laws including N.J.S.A. 10:2-1 through 10:2-4, N.J.S.A. 10:5-1 et seq., N.J.S.A. 10:5-31 through 10:5-38, and all rules and regulations thereunder.

rfp_requirements.title: Optional additional information - Compliance
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Compliance (CP) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional Maintenance Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Additional Threat Management Information
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to this control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional threat management information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the threat management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement proactive vulnerability and patch management program
rfp_requirements.description: The organization implements proactive vulnerability identification, remediation, and patch management practices to minimize the risk of a loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information systems, networks, components, and applications.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional vulnerability/patch management information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the vulnerability and patch management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional system development information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the system development and acquisition control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional project/resource management information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the project and resource management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Plan, prepare, and measure capacity of compute, storage, memory, and network resources
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure the availability, quality, and adequate capacity of compute, storage, memory, and network resources are planned, prepared, and measured to deliver the required system performance and future capacity requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe scaling and availability controls
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe processes and controls employed to ensure information systems scale appropriately and meet availability needs, including DDoS protections, automated provisioning, high-availability, etc.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional capacity/performance information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the capacity and performance management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional third-party management information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the third-party management control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional physical/environmental security information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the physical and environmental security control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional contingency planning information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the contingency planning control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional information on contingency planning (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the contingency planning control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Quote per Quote Submission Requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must submit their quote in accordance with quote submission requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Mobilization Plan with Quote
rfp_requirements.description: Each Bidder shall include as part of its Quote a mobilization plan, beginning with the date of notification of Contract award and lasting no longer than two (2) weeks.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Draft CIF Network and Lane Configuration Plan with Quote
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder shall submit a draft CIF Network and Lane Configuration Plan with Quote Submission; final due Start + 60 days. See Section 4.9.2.2.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional information on incident response (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the incident response control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor personnel must be professional and courteous
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor personnel must be responsive, polite, and cooperative when interacting with MVC, DEP, OIT, State employees, and customers, and perform all work in a courteous, professional manner at all times.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform Research
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must perform research as specified in Section 4.11.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Commercial General Liability Insurance at $1,000,000 per occurrence
Professional Liability minimum $1,000,000 in State-approved form
Define and perform archiving
Perform other DBA activities as required
Detail periodic system maintenance tasks
Provide security features to protect file integrity
Enforce role-based information access
Conform to Revised File Transfer Method/Format
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall conform to all requirements if the State revises or changes the file transfer method and/or format during the Contract term.

rfp_requirements.title: Use nj.gov Domain and Current Naming Standards
rfp_requirements.description: New web pages must conform to current naming standards and use nj.gov domain.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain Layout/Functions of Current Repair Information Webpage
rfp_requirements.description: The vehicle repair information shall use the same layout and functions of the current generation repair information webpage.

rfp_requirements.title: Meet quantitative performance per approved ATP documents
rfp_requirements.description: Satisfactory quantitative performance as specified in the approved ATP documents must be met by the Contractor, as evidenced by written SCM approval.

rfp_requirements.title: Meet 98% call answer performance within 10 minutes
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall provide enough telephone lines and CCRs to ensure 98% of calls are received and placed in a queue and answered within 10 minutes from queue entry during routine Motorist Hotline Business Hours.

rfp_requirements.title: Support public information and consumer protection program
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must assist and support the State in meeting State and Federal (40 CFR 51) requirements and cooperatively develop a public information and consumer protection program for statewide distribution.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Public Information Officer
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall provide a Public Information Officer (PIO) who shall begin immediately following Contract award and continue to assist the State throughout the Operations Phase.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain SCM recommendation and Director's written approval before additional work
Refine QA Plan during Implementation Phase
rfp_requirements.description: During Implementation Phase, QA Manager, IOC, and SCM shall work together to refine and revise the draft QA Plan submitted in the Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide deliverables in hard copy, PDF, and Word/Excel
rfp_requirements.description: For all document deliverables, provide a hard copy as requested by SCM, an electronic read-only PDF (or equivalent), and a read/write Microsoft Word or Excel (or equivalent) format.

rfp_requirements.title: Include exterior site work including wait gate replacement
rfp_requirements.description: Plan must include exterior site work at each site, including anticipated replacement of existing wait gate system.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit alternate UVIS solutions for SCM review
rfp_requirements.description: Any alternate UVIS solution must be submitted for SCM review (analyst entry truncated in source).

rfp_requirements.title: Conform captured videos/images to Data Security Requirements
rfp_requirements.description: All captured and stored videos and images shall conform to Bid Solicitation Section 6, Data Security Requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish privacy safeguards for PII
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must establish appropriate processes and safeguards necessary to protect PII collected, stored, processed, used, and transmitted on behalf of the State of New Jersey.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct due diligence reviews of third parties
rfp_requirements.description: Conduct due diligence security reviews of suppliers and third parties with access to Contractor's systems and sensitive information.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe and submit privacy program
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must describe its privacy program and how it maintains currency with evolving applicable privacy requirements, and submit a copy of or provide a link to the privacy program.

rfp_requirements.title: Optional additional information - Privacy
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Privacy (PR) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit properly executed performance security before payment
rfp_requirements.description: Properly executed performance security, when required, must be received by the State prior to processing any payments for goods and services accepted by state agencies.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not obtain rights in State Data
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall not obtain any right, title, or interest in any State Data or information derived from State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Personal Data privacy statutes
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must comply with all applicable international, federal, and state statutory and regulatory requirements for Personal Data including HIPAA, IRS Publication 1075, NJ tax confidentiality statute, NJ Identity Theft Prevention Act, federal Drivers' Privacy Protection Act, and N.J.S.A. § 39:2-3

rfp_requirements.title: Implement safeguards for user information
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must take appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards reasonably designed to protect the security, privacy, confidentiality, and integrity of user information.

rfp_requirements.title: Request minimum necessary State Data
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must ensure State Data requested represents the minimum necessary information and that only necessary individuals/entities bound by the Contract access it.

rfp_requirements.title: Return State Data upon Contract termination
rfp_requirements.description: Upon termination/expiration, Contractor must first return all State Data to the State in a usable format as defined in the Contract, or in an open standards machine-readable format if not.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit performance security with bid if required
rfp_requirements.description: If performance security is required, such security must be submitted with the bid in the amount listed in the scope of work (N.J.A.C. 17:12-2.5).

rfp_requirements.title: Include Small/Minority/Women/Veteran/Labor Surplus Firms in Solicitation Lists
rfp_requirements.description: If subawards are to be made, include small businesses, minority businesses, women's business enterprises, veteran-owned businesses, and labor surplus area firms in solicitation lists.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnify for Intellectual Property Rights claims
rfp_requirements.description: Indemnification applies to use of any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret, or other proprietary right furnished or used in performance of the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Optional additional information - Asset Management
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Asset Management (AM) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Carry Professional Liability Insurance
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must carry Errors and Omissions, Professional Liability Insurance, and/or Professional Liability Malpractice Insurance sufficient to protect the Contractor from liability arising out of its professional obligations under the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Carry Cyber Breach Insurance
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must carry Cyber Breach Insurance in an amount sufficient to protect the Contractor from liability arising out of its performance under the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Section 6002 of Solid Waste Disposal Act
rfp_requirements.description: Where applicable in contract performance, comply with section 6002 of the Solid Waste Disposal Act, as amended by the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act of 1976, 42 U.S.C. 6962.

rfp_requirements.title: EPA Comprehensive Procurement Guidelines Reference
rfp_requirements.description: Information about the recovered materials requirement, along with the list of EPA-designated items, is available at EPA's Comprehensive Procurement Guidelines web site: https://www.epa.gov/smm/comprehensive-procurement-guideline-cpg-program.

rfp_requirements.title: Take Enforcement Action on Subcontracts as Directed
rfp_requirements.description: Take such action with respect to any subcontract or purchase order as the administering agency may direct as a means of enforcing such provisions, including sanctions for noncompliance.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with 37 CFR Part 401 for Inventions Under Funding Agreement
rfp_requirements.description: If the Federal award meets the definition of 'funding agreement' under 37 CFR § 401.2(a) and the Contractor wishes to enter into a contract with a small business firm or nonprofit regarding substitution of parties, assignment, or performance of experimental, developmental, or research work, comply w

rfp_requirements.title: Flow down Clean Air Act requirements to subcontracts over $150,000
rfp_requirements.description: Include Clean Air Act requirements in each subcontract exceeding $150,000 financed in whole or in part with Federal assistance provided by FEMA.

rfp_requirements.title: Flow down Water Pollution Control Act requirements to subcontracts over $150,000
rfp_requirements.description: Include Water Pollution Control Act requirements in each subcontract exceeding $150,000 financed in whole or in part with Federal assistance provided by FEMA.

rfp_requirements.title: Personal Data definition incorporating NJ, HIPAA, and FERPA standards
rfp_requirements.description: Personal Data includes 'Personal Information' as defined in N.J.S.A. 56:8-161 (name plus SSN, driver's license/state ID, or financial account info), plus PII, government-issued IDs, Protected Health Information (HIPAA, P.L. 104-191, 45 CFR Parts 160–164), and Education Records under FERPA (20 U.S.C.

rfp_requirements.title: Respond to Request for Revision only for stated reasons
rfp_requirements.description: If the State issues a Request for Revision within NJSTART, the Bidder shall respond only for the reason(s) identified by the State. Any other changes made by the Bidder will be considered null and void.

rfp_requirements.title: Director's right to reject any/all Quotes and award in whole or in part
rfp_requirements.description: The Director reserves the right to reject any or all Quotes, or to award in whole or in part if deemed in the best interest of the State, and has authority to award Contracts in accordance with N.J.S.A. 52:34-12.

rfp_requirements.title: Optional additional information - Security Categorization
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Security Categorization (SC) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Limitation of liability – 200% of Contract value, minimum $1,000,000
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor's liability to the State for actual and direct damages related to performance is limited in the aggregate to 200% of the total Contract value, but in no event less than $1,000,000.

rfp_requirements.title: No audit right created where none exists in Contractor agreement
rfp_requirements.description: In the event that the contractor's proposal or Standard Form Agreement does not permit audits of the State's usage of Contractor Intellectual Property, Section 5.19 of this Supplement shall not be interpreted to provide such an audit right.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish media and cryptographic protection controls
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must establish controls to ensure data and information, in all forms and mediums, are protected throughout their lifecycles based on sensitivity, value, and criticality, and impact of loss of confidentiality, integrity, availability, and privacy on the organization, business partners, or indi

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 30 days advance notice of upgrades
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must give advance notice to the State of any upgrades (major, minor, system changes) that may impact service availability and performance at least 30 days in advance, unless otherwise agreed in SLA.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide regular updates on Security Incidents
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide the State regular updates and all available relevant information, including a description of the incident and measures taken in response.

rfp_requirements.title: Orderly return and disposal of State Data on termination
rfp_requirements.description: Upon contract termination, Contractor must implement an orderly return of State Data in a mutually agreeable format and securely dispose of remaining State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Carry Cyber Breach Insurance of at least $2,000,000
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must carry Cyber Breach Insurance sufficient to protect against liability, in an amount not less than $2,000,000, in policy forms approved by the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional info on Media and Cryptographic Protection
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the Media and Cryptographic Protection control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Refer to Appendix A – Glossary for data type and security categorization definitions
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must use Appendix A – Glossary for definitions of data types and security categorization when completing Section II.

rfp_requirements.title: Exhibit A - Dues authorization form
rfp_requirements.description: The Agreement references Exhibit A as the form for voluntary written authorization for dues deductions; this exhibit is an attached required form.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain voluntary written COPE authorization (Exhibit B)
rfp_requirements.description: Upon receipt of a voluntary written authorization from an Employee in the form annexed as Exhibit B, the Employer shall deduct monthly the specified sum and remit to Local 518 SEIU/COPE.

rfp_requirements.title: Exhibit B - COPE authorization form
rfp_requirements.description: The Agreement references Exhibit B as the form for voluntary written authorization for SEIU/COPE Political Action Fund deductions; this exhibit is an attached required form.

rfp_requirements.title: Furnish weekly new hire and termination information to Union
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer agrees to furnish the Union each week with names of newly hired Employees (addresses, classifications, location, dates of hire), names/dates of terminated or suspended Employees, and names of Employees on leave of absence.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure remitted funds conform to applicable laws
rfp_requirements.description: Once funds are remitted to the Union, their disposition shall be the sole and exclusive obligation of the Union and shall conform to applicable laws governing collection and use of Employee dues.

rfp_requirements.title: Discipline by telephone or fax with Union consent
rfp_requirements.description: With the consent of the Union, the Employer may impose discipline on an Employee by telephone or fax. The Union and Employer may transmit information during a disciplinary investigation by telephone or fax.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit names of Union representatives in writing
rfp_requirements.description: Names of Union representatives at each location shall be submitted in writing to the Personnel Office by the Union President/Vice President or designee upon execution of this Agreement, and the Employer shall be advised in writing of any changes.

rfp_requirements.title: Inform Employee of right to Union representation at investigatory interviews
rfp_requirements.description: At any investigatory interview or initiation of disciplinary action, or when requested to provide a written statement, the Employee shall be informed of the opportunity to have a Union representative present.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow fill of same/lower classification vacancy at station
rfp_requirements.description: A laid-off Lane Technician may fill a vacancy in the same or lower classification at his/her station if able to perform it.

rfp_requirements.title: Serve 30-workday probationary period on promotion
rfp_requirements.description: A promoted employee must serve a 30-workday probationary period on the new job; unpaid leave does not count. If removed during probation, returns to former job with right to displace least senior employee without loss of seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Right to return to bargaining unit within 60 days
rfp_requirements.description: An employee promoted to a job outside the bargaining unit has the right to return to the bargaining unit in former title and location within 60 days of promotion; discipline outside unit is not grievable.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit written request for sick leave exceeding 10 days
rfp_requirements.description: Employees needing sick leave for more than 10 days must request leave in writing to their immediate manager.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify management and furnish evidence of special leave duty
rfp_requirements.description: Employee shall notify management immediately of required leave and furnish evidence of performance of the duty for which leave was requested.

rfp_requirements.title: Fill vacancies from transfer preference list by earliest request
rfp_requirements.description: All vacancies shall be filled first from the transfer preference list by the Employee who submitted the earliest request; ties broken by bargaining unit seniority, then lottery.

rfp_requirements.title: Void prior Lane Technician transfer requests upon promotion
rfp_requirements.description: For Lane Technicians, upon promotion, all prior transfer requests on file become null and void; a new request may be submitted.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Friday vacation request by prior Wednesday 2:00 p.m. to exclude Saturday
rfp_requirements.description: If requesting a vacation day that includes a Friday, Employee will not be charged vacation for the following Saturday if the request is made by the previous Wednesday at 2:00 p.m.; otherwise eligible for drafting.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit vacation cash-out request with 30 days written notice
rfp_requirements.description: Requests to cash out vacation time shall be given with at least 30 days written notice; requests granted and paid only during first pay period of June and/or December; only prior year carryover may be cashed out.

rfp_requirements.title: Attach detailed statement identifying exempt Quote sections
rfp_requirements.description: If Company objects to disclosure of any portions of the Quote, Company must advise the Division and attach a detailed statement clearly identifying those sections of the Quote claimed exempt from disclosure.

rfp_requirements.title: Select one confidentiality option on the form
rfp_requirements.description: Company must select one of the following options: (a) Quote does not include confidential/proprietary/trade secrets and no redactions requested; OR (b) Quote does include such material and redactions are requested with supporting attached statement.

rfp_requirements.title: Issuing Agency and End-User Agencies
rfp_requirements.description: Solicitation is issued by the NJ Department of the Treasury, Division of Purchase and Property on behalf of the NJ Motor Vehicle Commission and NJ Department of Environmental Protection.

rfp_requirements.title: Continuing obligation to notify State of changes to Disclosure of Investigations
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor is under a continuing obligation from the date of the Disclosure of Investigations certification through completion of any contract(s) with the State to notify the State in writing of any changes to the information contained therein.

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose criminal/disorderly persons arrests, charges, indictments, convictions
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must disclose whether any person or entity listed on the form or its attachments has ever been arrested, charged, indicted, or convicted in a criminal or disorderly persons matter by the State of New Jersey (or political subdivision), any other state, or the U.S. Government.
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investigations Form - Part 2 Q1

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose suspensions, debarments, or ineligibility actions
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must disclose whether any person or entity listed on the form or its attachments has ever been suspended, debarred or otherwise declared ineligible by any government agency from bidding or contracting to provide services, labor, materials or supplies.
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investigations Form - Part 2 Q2

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose currently pending criminal/debarment proceedings
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must disclose whether there are currently any pending criminal matters or debarment proceedings in which the firm and/or its officers and/or managers are involved.
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investigations Form - Part 2 Q3

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose denied or revoked licenses, permits, or authorizations
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must disclose whether any person or entity listed on the form or its attachments has been denied any license, permit or similar authorization required to engage in the work applied for, or has had any such license, permit or similar authorization revoked by any agency of federal, state, or lo
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investigations Form - Part 2 Q4

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose adverse public-sector civil litigation in past 5 years
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must disclose whether any person or entity listed on the form or its attachments has been involved as an adverse party to a public sector client in any civil litigation or administrative proceeding in the past five (5) years.
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investigations Form - Part 2 Q5

rfp_requirements.title: Provide detailed description of any YES answers to Questions 1-5
rfp_requirements.description: If Bidder answered YES to any of Questions 1-5, must provide a detailed description of any investigation or litigation, including administrative complaints or proceedings involving public sector clients during the past five (5) years. Description must include nature and status of the investigation,

rfp_requirements.title: Provide specific case information for YES answers
rfp_requirements.description: For any YES answer to Questions 1-5, Bidder must provide the Person or Entity Name, Contact Name, Phone Number, Case Caption, Inception of the Investigation, Current Status, and Summary of Investigation.

rfp_requirements.title: Continuing obligation to notify State of changes to Iran certification
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor is under a continuing obligation from the date of certification through completion of any contract(s) with the State to notify the State in writing of any changes to the information contained in the Iran Disclosure.
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investment Activities in Iran Form

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge criminal liability for false statements on Iran certification
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must acknowledge that it is a criminal offense to make a false statement or misrepresentation in the Iran certification; such false statement may subject the Bidder to criminal prosecution and constitute a material breach permitting the State to declare any resulting contract(s) void and unen
rfp_requirements.section: Disclosure of Investment Activities in Iran Form - Certification

rfp_requirements.title: Warnings and Violations Must Produce an Err Entity
rfp_requirements.description: Warnings and Violations must produce an Err entity using the specified format with errorCode, errorLevel ('W' or 'V'), and errorDetails text.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Third-Party Information Security Questionnaire if applicable
rfp_requirements.description: Organizations that develop/implement/provide/manage/host State major systems and applications, general support systems, or have authorized access to State production environments, internal networks, and/or sensitive information are required to complete and submit the Third-Party Information Security

rfp_requirements.title: Implement additional risk mitigation controls if required prior to award
rfp_requirements.description: Based on criticality/sensitivity of the information system and information in scope, as well as legal, regulatory, and/or contractual requirements, the State may require the submitting organization to implement additional risk mitigation controls prior to the award of any contract or agreement.

rfp_requirements.title: Check one of two MacBride options
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must check the appropriate box indicating either (a) no business operations in Northern Ireland, or (b) will take lawful steps in good faith to conduct any Northern Ireland operations per MacBride principles.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify State of changes during contract term
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor is under a continuing obligation from date of certification through completion of any contract(s) with the State to notify the State in writing of any changes to the information contained in the MacBride certification.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete Security Due Diligence Third-Party Information Security Questionnaire
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor is required to complete the State of New Jersey Security Due Diligence Third-Party Information Security Questionnaire and provide applicable supporting documents, and include it with its Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge OPRA and Right to Know applicability
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must acknowledge that NJOHSP and the Division are public agencies subject to the New Jersey Open Public Records Act, N.J.S.A. 47:1A-1 et seq. ('OPRA'), and the common law Right to Know, which are construed in favor of granting public access.

rfp_requirements.title: Indicate if Vendor is a Non-Profit Entity
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must answer whether it is a Non-Profit Entity; if so, no disclosure is necessary on the Ownership Disclosure Form.

rfp_requirements.title: Indicate if Vendor is a corporation, partnership, or LLC
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must indicate (YES/NO) whether it is a corporation, partnership, or limited liability company on the Ownership Disclosure Form.

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose 10% or greater owners of vendor entity
rfp_requirements.description: If vendor is a corporation, partnership, or LLC with individuals, partners, members, stockholders, corporations, partnerships, or LLCs owning a 10% or greater interest, Bidder must disclose the names and addresses of all such 10% or greater owners.

rfp_requirements.title: Indicate if Vendor is a publicly traded company
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must answer YES/NO whether the vendor is a publicly traded company on the Ownership Disclosure Form.

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose publicly traded parent entity 10% beneficial owners and SEC filing links
rfp_requirements.description: A Vendor with any direct or indirect parent entity that is publicly traded may submit the name and address of each publicly traded entity and the name and address of each person holding a 10% or greater beneficial interest as of the last annual filing with the federal SEC or foreign equivalent, and

rfp_requirements.title: Spend at least 1% of operating budget on ongoing public information program
rfp_requirements.description: A contractor must spend not less than one percent of its operating budget to provide an ongoing public information program.

rfp_requirements.title: Dispute resolution procedures for unresolved contract disputes
rfp_requirements.description: If a dispute over contract compliance, performance, or termination cannot be resolved between the State Treasurer and contractor, either party may file with the Superior Court for an order to terminate the contract or for other appropriate relief.

rfp_requirements.title: Existing bidders afforded opportunity to amend or withdraw bids
rfp_requirements.description: An existing bidder must be afforded the opportunity to amend its bid to conform to such requirements or to withdraw its proposal from consideration for an award.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Quote on time with all mandatory requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must submit Quotes on time addressing all mandatory requirements (designated by 'shall'), including forms, or Quotes may be deemed non-responsive.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide NJ State Government Sponsoring Department/Agency Information
rfp_requirements.description: Complete sponsor agency information, including Sponsoring Department/Agency, sponsor first/last name, title, email and phone.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit written information security policies and standards
rfp_requirements.description: Submit a copy of the organization's written information security policies and standards as supporting documentation with the questionnaire.

Dear Ms. Grabuloff,
Parsons Transportation Group Inc. (Parsons) is pleased to provide this proposal to the Pennsylvania Department of
Transportation (PennDOT), Bureau of Office Services, in response to Request for Proposal (RFP) Number 3522R12
for Emissions Program Management.
Our commitment to PennDOT is to continue delivering an effective Pennsylvania Vehicle Emissions Inspection and
Maintenance Program and to innovate responsibly to move the Program forward. Building on our past performance,
we will implement new, cloud-based VIID systems and improved auditing infrastructure that efficiently gets Program
data to PennDOT. Our upgrades to the e-SAFETY system will support the enhanced safety inspection Program
compliance. We will upgrade our call center solution with new technology using ZenDesk and AmazonConnect as
the backbone of the system.
Our Program Mana

auditor teams, support teams, and subcontractors are in place. In this challenging
labor market, we do not anticipate any staffing impacts as your selected vendor in the new contract. Upon Notice to
Proceed, with no transitional risk to current operations, we will begin the implementation tasks to fulfill all RFP
requirements.
Parsons continues its commitment to Small Diverse Businesses and Small Businesses for this procurement.
Additionally, we have added two Veteran Business Enterprises to our team, 1Alpha Consulting to bolster our
motorist compliance activities and Berry Solutions Group for our information and education development and to
provide enhanced auditor training.
Offeror Responsibilities and Exceptions to the RFP Requirements
All information submitted pertains exclusively to Parsons Transportation Group Inc. as a subsidiary of Parsons
Corporation. Our proposal satisfies all mandatory requirements listed in the RFP, and we take no exceptions to any
of the contractual provisions outlined in the RFP.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
WORKING WITH PENNDOT TO MOVE THE I/M
PROGRAM FORWARD THROUGH ADAPTABILITY
AND INNOVATION
Parsons is uniquely positioned to deliver each requirement PennDOT has outlined for the new contract, enhancing what
works and innovating for the future. We’re fully committed to:
Applying innovation and advanced technology tailored to Pennsylvania’s Program
Ensuring station compliance
Employing advanced Cybersecurity protocols to protect against security threats
Eliminating PennDOT’s transition risk
Parsons appreciates PennDOT’s business. Throughout our response, we demonstrate our depth of experience, our
reliability, our compliance, and our adaptability. We have unmatched knowledge of PennDOT’s emissions and safety
programs, and we know what you require from your vendor. Most importantly, we won’t rest on our laurels; in this new
contract, we will demonstrate to PennDOT that we are the best vendor to bring the Program into the future.
Highlights of Parsons’ Technical Proposal
Secure Data and Information Management Systems. Our systems are reliable, and we are proud of the 99.99% uptime
of our Pennsylvania VIID. Program downtime is simply unacceptable to us, and our experien

nfrastructure that affords PennDOT the confidence to move forward. Protecting
data and information from loss, intrusion, and sophisticated cyber-attacks is critical to our data and management
systems. Our dedicated Pennsylvania team includes cybersecurity professionals, reinforced by a company-wide
Cybersecurity Practice that serves federal and state governments. Across our entire company, we integrate data and
information security from the ground up through system design, system development, and day-to-day operations and
maintenance. The Pennsylvania VIID has never had a security or performance issue, and we will keep it that way.
Mindful Innovation. To maintain critical service continuity, and with PennDOT’s approval, we will migrate all systems to
the Amazon Web Service (AWS) cloud environment. The system upgrade will provide efficient change management
implementation to adapt to future Program enhancements. The cloud-based VIID will include expanded reporting and
data management features along with robust scalability, security, and recovery. The upgraded system will allow
PennDOT faster access to overt and covert audit data for the I/M and safety and enhanced safety programs. P

Equipment Certification. Parsons has certified all equipment used by the stations, from the days of tailpipe and
dynamometer testing to today’s OBD equipment. Our experienced and knowledgeable equipment certification team is
ready to support tomorrow’s vehicle communication protocols. We are not an equipment provider in Pennsylvania, and
this separation allows us to conduct impartial equipment testing, which is key to Program success and integrity. We
reliably ensure equipment performance that promotes consumer confidence.
Vendor Compliance. PennDOT expects its vendors to comply with all contract requirements. As part of Parsons’
compliance commitment, we will introduce our Service Level Tracking Application (SLTA) in AWS. The SLTA provides a
summary of the service level agreements that PennDOT has clearly stated in this RFP and identifies the delivery of the
task required, providing PennDOT with a way to ensure we meet our contractual obligations.
We will augment our compliance validation with professionals from Michael Baker International. They will provide third-
party validation of completed audit numbers and support evaluation of the I/M Program and oversight activities. They

t. This will reinforce confidence in Parsons’ deliverables.
A Team with Depth that Will Deliver for Pennsylvania. Success starts with experienced leadership, and Parsons brings a
trusted Program team. Mark Colangelo, Vice President and Pennsylvania Program Manager, has extensive knowledge of
Commonwealth requirements, policies, and procedures, strengthened by his many years of industry experience. Backed by
his in-place team and handpicked DBE/SBE/VBE companies, we stand ready to support your initiatives and deliver your
Program. Mike Butler, Vice President and Smart Vehicles Solutions Business Leader, and Bonnie McPherson, Vice President,
Vehicle Inspection Programs, will support Mark in making sure he has the full complement of Corporate resources and staff
required to meet your goals.
Parsons brings a mindful and respectful approach to innovation that aligns with PennDOT’s priorities. PennDOT has and
can continue to rely on us to deliver innovation based on its goals. We have carefully reviewed the RFP offered by
PennDOT and offer a responsible, respectful, and thorough response with solid, performance-based delivery on all the
outlined tasks.

I-1. STATEMENT OF THE PROJECT
Pennsylvania operates one of the largest, longest-running decentralized Vehicle Emissions Inspection and Maintenance
(I/M) Programs in the United States. The Commonwealth’s I/M Program, divided into four regions, has grown to around
8,200 stations throughout 25 counties since 1997. PennDOT estimates nearly 7 million vehicles will be subject to
inspection by 2025. The Program design provides consumer convenience, supports private inspection stations, and
improves air quality. Stations in the Program are responsible for maintaining inspection equipment appropriate for the
required inspection types in the given region.
PennDOT is seeking a reliable, experienced Offeror to provide Emissions Program Management and continue the
successful operations of the I/M Program, overseeing safety inspection stations and related systems to keep consumer
and inspection station costs as low as possible while maintaining vehicle and consumer safety. The Program must
comply with federal and state requirements while providing adaptability for future Progr

l ensure the continued success of your Program through our strong foundational Program
knowledge and performance history of compliance and adaptability with no transition risk. We understand the need
for complete separation and no conflict of interest between PennDOT’s Emissions Program Manager and emissions
equipment providers. We are the only contractor that can guarantee no financial or business relationship with any
currently certified emissions testing equipment manufacturer in Pennsylvania.
The selected Program Manager will administer all aspects of the I/M Program under PennDOT’s direction, including the
required services defined in the RFP and outlined in work statement Part I-6. The contractor’s responsibilities include:
§ Maintaining the nature and scope of Pennsylvania’s current I/M Program
§ Maintaining required geographic coverage and program areas
§ Providing a seamless transition that prevents interruption in Program services or data collection by maintaining
interfaces with hardware and software and ensuring emission testing equipment transmits data to the Vehicle
Information Inspection Database (VIID) identically
§ Providing for the storage and handling of all I/M

d safety inspection data
§ Providing the necessary software/hardware to operate and maintain the I/M Program
§ Providing a disaster recovery plan
§ Providing data back-up and off-site back-up storage
§ Providing system journal files (transaction journals), logging all system transactions
§ Overseeing (overt, covert, and remote visual observation) I/M and Safety stations within the assigned geographic
region including inspectors and certified repair technicians
§ Conducting public information and education (I&E) activities relating to the I/M Program
§ Providing a process for investigation and fact-finding relating to I/M Program violations
§ Providing referee service to facilitate the resolution of consumer complaints
§ Helping I/M stations and consumers with the issuance of exemptions and waivers
§ Providing Help Desk facilities to address equipment manufacturer, I/M station, and consumer questions and
concerns regarding I/M Program requirements and to address system support issues for e-SAFETY users
§ Performing motorist compliance data collection and analysis
§ Collecting, organizing, storing, and reporting on data related to on-road testing (remote sensing)
§ Performing evaluat

nspection stations and personnel, primarily in I/M-affected counties throughout Pennsylvania
§ Providing a process for investigation and fact-finding regarding safety inspection regulation violations
§ Providing necessary periodic and ad hoc reports and project control utilities to monitor Program performance
§ Enhancing the current e-SAFETY system, which electronically collects safety inspection data, as directed by
PennDOT
We’ve consistently worked with PennDOT to realize your vision through the successful implementation of policy,
requirement, and regulatory changes. In 2012, we seamlessly transitioned more than 8,000 stations to our VIID to
ensure Program continuity. In 2016, we helped revise the OBD inspection equipment specification, replacing dial-up field
equipment with modern, web-based OBD equipment and then performing acceptance testing to certify the equipment for

§ Operational continuity—our experienced team will manage the daily operational tasks of the I/M Program.

industry and the motoring public in alignment with your goals. As part of our commitment to SDB inclusion, we’re
teaming with two Harrisburg-based firms to help fulfill the I&E Program.
§ Experienced Court of Common Pleas

and expert testimony in support of PennDOT sanctions against stations and inspectors.
§ Program continuity—we have the knowledge to support all three equipment platforms, four manufacturers, and two
equipment specifications and the infrastructure to support legacy dial-up connectivity.
Parsons ensures a risk-free transition and reliability for PennDOT to ensure the
I/M Program’s exceptional operational performance and customer service.

Parsons is a global, 18,000+-person company with 79 years of experience supporting complex programs for its clients.
We entered the vehicle inspection industry in 1984, providing referee services for the California Bureau of Automotive
Repair; our vehicle inspection team began working with PennDOT at the Program’s inception that led to public safety and
a cleaner environment. We deliver cybersecurity, advanced technology solutions, and other services to federal, regional,
and local government agencies and national and international private industrial customers. Our agile and innovative
approach enables us to deliver solutions that satisfy our client’s current and future initiatives.

compliant, on-time delivery with no disruptions or negative customer impacts.
